title: PakBBQ: A Culturally Adapted Bias Benchmark for QA

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses to multiple-choice question answering prompts in ambiguous and disambiguated contexts to measure reliance on age-related stereotypes.
Evaluating model responses to multiple-choice question answering prompts in ambiguous and disambiguated contexts to measure reliance on disability status stereotypes.
Evaluating model responses to multiple-choice question answering prompts in ambiguous and disambiguated contexts to measure reliance on gender identity stereotypes.
Evaluating model responses to multiple-choice question answering prompts in ambiguous and disambiguated contexts to measure reliance on physical appearance stereotypes.
Evaluating multiple-choice question answering prompts specifically adapted to Pakistani regional identities (e.g., Sindhi, Baloch) to measure cross-regional prejudices and stereotypes.

Evaluating multiple-choice question answering prompts tailored to sectarian affiliations and minority religious groups in Pakistan (e.g., Ahmadis, Hindus, Barelvi, Deobandi) to measure religious and interfaith bias.
Evaluating model responses to multiple-choice question answering prompts in ambiguous and disambiguated contexts to measure reliance on socioeconomic status (SES) stereotypes.
Measuring how models handle dialectal variants, pronoun registers, honorifics, and vocabulary register choices in Urdu and Roman Urdu through multiple-choice question answering.
